bounds: Two request identities and one refresh for reuse/default cases. Two requests and two overlapping refreshes for overlap. Each request has at most two probes and two native invocations. Readiness is an abstract success/failure completion of ensure(); generations never wrap.

assumptions: Weak fairness of each admitted request completion and pending refresh completion. Provider status, readiness and response operations eventually settle; arbitrary permanent provider hangs are outside this progress claim.
One or two explicit refresh generations are available, so refresh churn cannot continue forever. Native invocation is modeled, not rollback of provider effects already invoked.
